questions.question: Which word is used to connect two contrasting ideas?

steps: However is used to introduce a contrast between two ideas.
solution.summary: However shows a contrast.

questions.explanation: He trained hard; however, he did not win.

questions.question: What does moreover mean?

options.A: in addition to what was said

questions.correct_answer_text: in addition to what was said

steps: Moreover means in addition to what has already been mentioned.
solution.summary: Moreover adds extra information.

questions.explanation: She is fast; moreover, she is very strong.

questions.question: Which connector is used to add another point?

steps: In addition is used to add more information to a point.
solution.summary: In addition introduces another related idea.

questions.explanation: He won the race. In addition, he broke the record.

questions.question: Which word shows an opposite idea to the previous statement?

steps: On the other hand introduces a different or contrasting viewpoint.
solution.summary: On the other hand presents an alternative perspective.

questions.explanation: Tennis is a solo sport. On the other hand, football is a team sport.

questions.question: What is a reporting verb used in journalism?

steps: Announced is a reporting verb used when someone makes a public statement.
solution.summary: Reporting verbs are used to report what someone said.

questions.explanation: The coach announced the team lineup.

questions.question: Which reporting verb means to tell the truth about something?

steps: Admitted means to confess or acknowledge something is true.
solution.summary: Admitted means accepting that something is true.

questions.explanation: He admitted that he did not train enough.

questions.question: What does explained mean as a reporting verb?

steps: Explained means to make something easier to understand.
solution.summary: Explained means giving details to clarify something.

questions.explanation: The coach explained the new strategy to the team.

questions.question: Which connector is used to give an example?

steps: For example introduces a specific instance to support a point.
solution.summary: For example introduces an example.

questions.explanation: Many sports are popular; for example, football and basketball.

questions.question: What does a report typically include at the beginning?

steps: A report starts with an introduction that states the topic.
solution.summary: The introduction explains what the report is about.

questions.explanation: The report begins with an introduction about the event.

questions.question: Which connector means as a result of something?

steps: Therefore introduces a result or consequence.
solution.summary: Therefore shows the result of something.

questions.explanation: She trained every day; therefore, she improved quickly.

questions.question: What is the opposite of admitted?

steps: Denied means to say something is not true.
solution.summary: Denied means refusing to accept something.

questions.explanation: He denied breaking the rules.

questions.question: Which connector is used to show a reason?

steps: Because introduces a reason or cause.
solution.summary: Because shows the reason for something.

questions.explanation: She won because she trained very hard.

questions.question: What does the connector although mean?

steps: Although introduces a contrasting idea.
solution.summary: Although shows a contrast between two ideas.

questions.explanation: Although it rained, the match continued.

questions.question: Which reporting verb means to officially tell people something?

steps: Announced means to make a public or official statement.
solution.summary: Announced means telling everyone in a formal way.

questions.explanation: The school announced the results of the competition.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a conclusion in a report?

steps: The conclusion summarizes the main points of a report.
solution.summary: A conclusion wraps up the report by reviewing key ideas.

questions.explanation: The conclusion reminded readers of the most important facts.

questions.question: Which word best completes: She is a great athlete. ___, she is also a good student.

steps: Moreover adds extra positive information.
solution.summary: Moreover adds more information that supports the previous idea.

questions.explanation: Moreover shows she has more than one good quality.

questions.question: What does suggested mean as a reporting verb?

steps: Suggested means to put forward an idea for consideration.
solution.summary: Suggested means proposing something for others to think about.

questions.explanation: The captain suggested a new training plan.

questions.question: Which connector is used to contrast two things?

steps: On the contrary introduces an opposite point.
solution.summary: On the contrary shows a strong contrast.

questions.explanation: The game was not easy. On the contrary, it was very hard.

questions.question: What is a heading in a report?

steps: A heading is a title that labels each section of a report.
solution.summary: Headings organize a report into clear sections.

questions.explanation: Use headings to make your report easy to read.

questions.question: Which reporting verb means to say something in a low voice?

steps: Whispered means speaking very softly and quietly.
solution.summary: Whispered means speaking so only nearby people can hear.

questions.explanation: She whispered the answer to her friend.

questions.question: What does the connector furthermore add?

steps: Furthermore adds more information to strengthen a point.
solution.summary: Furthermore is another way to say in addition.

questions.explanation: He is a good player. Furthermore, he is a great leader.

questions.question: Which connector means for this reason?

steps: Therefore introduces a logical result or conclusion.
solution.summary: Therefore connects a cause to its effect.

questions.explanation: The team trained hard; therefore, they won the match.

questions.question: What is the purpose of an introduction in a report?

options.A: to state the topic and give background

questions.correct_answer_text: to state the topic and give background

steps: The introduction gives background information about the topic.
solution.summary: An introduction tells the reader what the report is about.

questions.explanation: The introduction explains why the event was important.

questions.question: Which reporting verb means to formally present something?

steps: Presented means to formally show or introduce something.
solution.summary: Presented means showing something in a formal setting.

questions.explanation: The team presented their results to the school.

questions.question: What does despite mean in a sentence?

steps: Despite introduces a fact that contrasts with the main clause.
solution.summary: Despite shows that something happened even though there was a problem.

questions.explanation: Despite the rain, the fans came to watch.

questions.question: Which is the correct order for a sports report?

steps: A sports report follows the structure: introduction, body, conclusion.
solution.summary: A report should have a clear beginning, middle, and end.

questions.explanation: Start with an introduction, then the body, and end with a conclusion.

questions.question: What does the connector consequently mean?

steps: Consequently means as a result or outcome.
solution.summary: Consequently shows the effect of something.

questions.explanation: He did not practice; consequently, he lost the match.

questions.question: Which word is NOT a reporting verb?

steps: Running is a physical action, not a reporting verb.
solution.summary: Reporting verbs are used to report speech or statements.

questions.explanation: Stated, explained, and admitted are reporting verbs.

questions.question: What is a fact in a report?

options.A: information that can be proven true

questions.correct_answer_text: information that can be proven true

steps: A fact is information that can be verified or proven.
solution.summary: Facts are true and can be checked.

questions.explanation: The team won 3-0 is a fact.

questions.question: Which connector means because of this?

steps: As a result introduces a consequence.
solution.summary: As a result shows what happened because of something.

questions.explanation: The player was injured; as a result, he missed the game.

questions.question: What does the word opinion mean in report writing?

steps: An opinion is a personal view or belief.
solution.summary: Opinions express what someone thinks about something.

questions.explanation: In my opinion, the best player was number 7.

questions.question: Which connector is used to show time order?

steps: Firstly, secondly, and finally organize events in time order.
solution.summary: Time connectors help sequence events in a report.

questions.explanation: Firstly, the teams entered the field. Secondly, the referee blew the whistle.

questions.question: What is the difference between a fact and an opinion?

options.A: a fact can be proven, an opinion is a belief

questions.correct_answer_text: a fact can be proven, an opinion is a belief

steps: Facts are provable truths; opinions are personal beliefs.
solution.summary: Facts can be checked, but opinions vary from person to person.

questions.explanation: He scored three goals is a fact. He is the best player is an opinion.

questions.question: Which reporting verb means to firmly state something?

steps: Insisted means to firmly state that something is true.
solution.summary: Insisted shows strong belief in a statement.

questions.explanation: The coach insisted that the team was ready.

questions.question: What does the connector alternatively mean?

steps: Alternatively introduces a different option.
solution.summary: Alternatively presents another possible choice.

questions.explanation: They could play football; alternatively, they could play basketball.

questions.question: Which part of a report gives facts and details about the topic?

steps: The body of a report contains the main facts and details.
solution.summary: The body is the main section with detailed information.

questions.explanation: The body of the report describes the event in detail.

questions.question: What does the connector similarly mean?

steps: Similarly shows that two things are alike in some way.
solution.summary: Similarly connects two comparable ideas.

questions.explanation: Football requires teamwork. Similarly, basketball needs cooperation.

questions.question: Which connector means in the end or as a final point?

steps: Finally introduces the last point in a list or sequence.
solution.summary: Finally shows the last item or idea.

questions.explanation: First they played, then they rested, and finally they celebrated.

questions.question: What is the correct structure of a sentence using although?

steps: Although introduces a dependent clause before the main clause.
solution.summary: The although clause comes before the main clause.

questions.explanation: Although he was tired, he continued to play.

questions.question: Which word is used to report what someone thinks?

steps: Believed is a reporting verb used for thoughts and opinions.
solution.summary: Believed reports what someone thinks about something.

questions.explanation: Many people believed the team would win.
